functions.name: ask_knowledge_base
functions.title: Ask the knowledge base
functions.description: Answers an operational question from MindVault's governed internal knowledge base (SOPs, trainings, procedures, decision rules). Returns a grounded answer with cited sources and a confidence level. Omit clientId to search firm-wide (general) knowledge; pass a Client record id to also include that client's client-specific knowledge.

clientId.description: Optional Client record id. Pass to include that client's client-specific knowledge in scope; omit for firm-wide general knowledge only.

conversation.description: Optional prior conversation turns for context, newest last. Each item is an object with a 'role' ('user' or 'assistant') and a 'content' string.
